tenancy.data_partitioning: Every lead, upload session, and alert references contractor_id for row-level isolation.

api_router.name: Receive Payload
actions: Validate contractor_id, customer_name, customer_phone_e164, zip_code, consent_granted, consent_timestamp, and video metadata.
Reject requests when consent_granted is false or consent_timestamp is missing.
Persist an audit event with the immutable ISO consent timestamp before upload starts.

api_router.name: Generate 24h Signed Link
actions: Create a private object key under contractor_id/lead_id/video.mp4.
Issue a presigned PUT upload URL for the browser.
After finalize, generate a signed GET URL that expires exactly 24 hours after issuance.

api_router.name: Construct Twilio MMS string with proper STOP opting-out instructions
actions: Build a concise diagnostic text containing customer name, phone, zip, and the signed 24-hour video link.
Append 'Reply STOP to opt out.' to align with messaging compliance requirements.
Use the tenant's Messaging Service SID so each contractor maps to the correct sender configuration.

api_router.name: Execute Twilio API request
actions: Send the MMS/SMS notification to contractors.notification_phone_e164.
Include the signed video link in the body for fast native thread rendering.
Persist delivery status callbacks back into lead_audit_events.
